name: Tiotropium
route_note: Once-daily dry-powder capsule (HandiHaler) or soft-mist inhaler (Respimat)
owner: Boehringer Ingelheim; generics in some markets

discovery.note: A quaternary ammonium anticholinergic designed for slow dissociation from M3 receptors, allowing once-daily dosing.

tagline: Once-daily inhaled anticholinergic, a cornerstone of COPD maintenance therapy
summary: Tiotropium is a long-acting muscarinic antagonist taken once daily by inhalation. It was the first once-daily bronchodilator for COPD, reduces exacerbations, and is also approved as add-on maintenance therapy in asthma.
mechanism: Acetylcholine released from vagal nerves contracts airway smooth muscle and stimulates mucus secretion via M3 muscarinic receptors. Tiotropium competitively blocks these receptors, producing bronchodilation.

It dissociates very slowly from M1 and M3 receptors but faster from M2 (the presynaptic autoreceptor), giving kinetic selectivity and a bronchodilator effect lasting more than 24 hours. As a quaternary amine it is poorly absorbed, limiting systemic anticholinergic effects.
uses: Maintenance treatment of COPD and reduction of exacerbations

history.title: First approval
history.detail: Spiriva HandiHaler is first approved for COPD, initially in Europe.

history.title: US approval
history.detail: FDA approves Spiriva HandiHaler for COPD in January.

history.title: UPLIFT trial
history.detail: Four-year UPLIFT trial shows improved lung function, quality of life and fewer exacerbations, without slowing FEV1 decline.

history.title: Respimat in the US
history.detail: FDA approves Spiriva Respimat for COPD after the TIOSPIR safety trial.

history.title: Asthma and combination
history.detail: Respimat is approved for asthma in the US, and tiotropium/olodaterol (Stiolto Respimat) for COPD.

history.title: WHO essential medicine
history.detail: Tiotropium is added to the WHO Model List of Essential Medicines for COPD.

history.title: US generic
history.detail: FDA approves a generic tiotropium inhalation powder (Lupin).

pk.metabolism: Minimal; non-enzymatic ester cleavage, minor CYP2D6 and CYP3A4

facts: Tiotropium was the first once-daily inhaled bronchodilator approved for COPD.
The HandiHaler capsules must not be swallowed; they are pierced in the device and the powder is inhaled.
